chunks: And from a sermon of him (peace be upon him) in which he alludes to the mention of the great events (al-Malahim).

key_terms.الْمَلَاحِمِ: The great battles or major events, often referring to eschatological conflicts.

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'al-Malahim' refer to in Imam Ali's sermons?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a sermon where Imam Ali (AS) alludes to 'al-Malahim' (the great battles), a key eschatological concept in Shia tradition denoting the major conflicts preceding the appearance of the Mahdi (AJ). The term specifically highlights the series of decisive wars that will reshape the global order, reflecting the Imam's deep insight into the trajectory of history and the eventual establishment of divine justice.
